description: This file defines a Jetpack Compose UI component for an Android TV application's top navigation bar. It includes a composable function TopNavBar that displays navigational items (including a search icon and category labels) with focus management suitable for TV remote navigation. It also defines a private composable FocusablePill for individual focusable pill-shaped items with focus styling and click handling.

classes.name: FocusablePill
classes.description: A small focusable pill-shaped UI component for navigation items that provides focus indication and handles click events, suitable for TV navigation.

methods.name: TopNavBar
methods.description: A composable function that renders a horizontal top navigation bar with focus management for TV, including a search icon and multiple category items.

methods.name: FocusablePill
methods.description: A private composable function that renders a focusable pill-shaped item with focus indication, icon or text, and click handling.
